fieldValues.title: Remedies carry a success condition and an outcome
fieldValues.move: Give the remedy type a `succeeds_when` field beside `falsifier`, and record the experiment outcome (untested, running, held, failed) apart from affirmation, so affirming a remedy means "worth trying", not "right".
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Does not show competing remedies or relate them; one remedy can be tested well while a better rival goes unseen.
fieldValues.falsifier: Affirmed remedies still reach epics with no success condition stated, or outcomes are never recorded after the work lands.
